definitions.explanation: A shop that sells fruits and vegetables.

examples.japanese: {八百屋|やおや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: To buy vegetables at the greengrocer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{近|ちか}く→近く：00923_chikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{八百屋|やおや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a greengrocer near the station.

examples.japanese: {八百屋|やおや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦トマト→トマト：05192_tomato⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The tomatoes at the greengrocer are fresh.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{八百屋|やおや}⟦さん→〜さん：09848_san⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦おいしい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: The vegetables at that greengrocer are always fresh and delicious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{八百屋|やおや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新鮮|しんせん}な→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I enjoy buying fresh vegetables and fruit at the greengrocer every morning.

notes:
{八百屋|やおや} is a traditional greengrocer selling fruits and vegetables.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{八百|やお}→八百：noentry⟧: 800 (meaning "many varieties")
- ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧: shop/store

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {八百屋|やおや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy at the greengrocer
- {八百屋|やおや}⟦さん→〜さん：09848_san⟧: the greengrocer (person)

TRADITIONAL SPECIALTY SHOPS:
- {八百屋|やおや}: greengrocer
- ⟦{肉屋|にくや}→肉屋：15233_nikuya⟧: butcher
- ⟦{魚屋|さかなや}→魚屋：14642_sakanaya⟧: fish shop
- ⟦{花屋|はなや}→花屋：03136_hanaya⟧: florist
- ⟦{酒屋|さかや}→酒屋：14436_sakaya⟧: liquor store
- ⟦{米屋|こめや}→米屋：noentry⟧: rice shop

USAGE:
While ⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧ dominate today, traditional {八百屋|やおや} still exist in ⟦{商店街|しょうてんがい}→商店街：09391_shoutengai⟧ (shopping streets) and are valued for fresh, local produce and personal service.
